verdict.rationale: Raygun documents automatic grouping by exception type, class name, method name and stack-trace location, plus hasher versions and status changes. Nothing in the evidence shows a way to manually merge duplicate error groups or split ones the hasher wrongly collapsed. Status workflows and hasher settings are adjacent controls and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can merge issues that are really the same bug and split ones the fingerprinter wrongly collapsed
